svg.title: vecdex: HNSW vector search in C++20
svg.desc: 18,000 queries per second at 96.4% recall@10 on SIFT1M, 1.78 times FAISS HNSW with the same parameters, 1M-vector build in 28 seconds on 10 threads. Chart: recall@10 against queries per second on SIFT1M for vecdex, FAISS HNSW and hnswlib; vecdex is fastest at every recall level.
